mapper.sql:
pay01_annual_id AS annual_id, pay01_company_id AS company_id, pay01_person_id AS person_id, pay01_start_date AS start_date, pay01_close_date AS close_date, pay01_start_time AS start_time, pay01_close_time AS close_time, pay01_month_ot_hours AS month_ot_hours, pay01_annual_pay AS annual_pay, pay01_retire_pay AS retire_pay, COALESCE(pay01_annual_pay, 0) + COALESCE(pay01_retire_pay, 0) AS year_pay, pay01_etc_agreement AS etc_agreement, pay01_basic_pay AS basic_pay, pay01_meal_pay AS meal_pay, pay01_car_mt AS car_mt, pay01_childcare_allowance AS childcare_allowance, pay01_over_pay AS over_pay, pay01_etc01_pay AS etc01_pay, pay01_etc02_pay AS etc02_pay, COALESCE(pay01_basic_pay,0) + COALESCE(pay01_meal_pay,0) + COALESCE(pay01_car_mt,0) + COALESCE(pay01_over_pay,0) + COALESCE(pay01_etc01_pay,0) + COALESCE(pay01_etc02_pay,0) + COALESCE(pay01_childcare_allowance,0) AS month_pay, pay01_note AS note, pay01_appr_id AS appr_id,
f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'pos_nm') AS pos_name,
f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, pay01_start_date::date, 'pos_nm') AS pos_name,
emp01_emp_no AS person_no, emp01_kor_nm AS person_name, emp01_hire_date AS hire_date, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, pay01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name, sys01_company_nm AS company_name, '('||COALESCE(sys01_zip_cd,'')||') '||COALESCE(sys01_zip_addr,'')||' '||COALESCE(sys01_zip_detail,'') AS company_address, ( SELECT emp01_kor_nm FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = pay01_company_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= pay01_start_date ) AND emp03_pos_cd = '100' AND emp03_trans_cd != '900' LIMIT 1 ) AS company_agent, ( SELECT emp02_birthday FROM emp02_others WHERE emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id ) AS birth_day, ( SELECT f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, pay01_start_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = pay01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date IN ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = pay01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= pay01_start_date ) ) AS org_name, ( SELECT '('||COALESCE(emp02_zip_cd,'')||')'||COALESCE(emp02_zip_addr,'')||' '||COALESCE(emp02_addr_detail,'') FROM emp02_others WHERE emp02_person_id = pay01_person_id ) AS person_address

FROM pay01_annual LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = pay01_appr_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON pay01_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = pay01_company_id

SELECT
WHERE pay01_company_id = #{companyId}
AND (pay01_person_id, pay01_start_date) IN ( SELECT a.pay01_person_id , MAX(a.pay01_start_date) FROM pay01_annual a LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = a.pay01_appr_id WHERE a.pay01_person_id = emp01_person_id AND a.pay01_start_date <= f_today()
AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'X') = '30' /*(30:완료)*/
GROUP BY a.pay01_person_id )
AND TO_CHAR(pay01_start_date,'yyyy') LIKE #{yearStr}
AND pay01_person_id NOT IN ( SELECT c.emp03_person_id FROM emp03_trans c WHERE pay01_person_id = c.emp03_person_id AND c.emp03_trans_cd = '900' )
AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'X') = '30' /*(30:완료)*/
ORDER BY f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, pay01_start_date::date, 'pos_cd') COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8", emp01_emp_no, pay01_start_date

INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_date01, sys99_date02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04 , sys99_long01, sys99_long02, sys99_long03, sys99_string05 , sys99_long04, sys99_long05, sys99_long06, sys99_long07, sys99_long08, sys99_long09 , sys99_long10, sys99_long11, sys99_string06, sys99_long12 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{printPersonId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , q.person_no, q.person_name, q.start_date, q.close_date, q.start_time, q.close_time , COALESCE(q.annual_pay, 0), COALESCE(q.retire_pay, 0), COALESCE(q.year_pay, 0), q.etc_agreement , COALESCE(q.basic_pay, 0), COALESCE(q.meal_pay, 0), COALESCE(q.car_mt, 0), COALESCE(q.over_pay, 0) , COALESCE(q.etc01_pay, 0), COALESCE(q.etc02_pay, 0) , COALESCE(q.month_pay, 0), COALESCE(q.childcare_allowance, 0), q.appr_status_name, COALESCE(q.month_ot_hours, 0)
